_meta.description: RoboCasa365 downloadable & fixed-base (moma_required=No) tasks — candidate subset for fixed-base (non-mobile) eval/train

excluded_fixed_base.name: PanTransfer
excluded_fixed_base.reason: Coverage orphan: unseen (zero-shot) eval task whose 'Serving Food' skill domain has ZERO fixed-base training coverage — all 4 same-activity train tasks (DessertUpgrade/PlaceFoodInBowls/PrepareSoupServing/ServeSteak) are moma_required=Yes (mobile) and were dropped by the fixed-base filter. The distinctive 'dump pan contents onto plate' (pour/transfer) primitive appears in 0 fixed-base train tasks. So a fixed-base-only policy is asked to zero-shot a domain it never saw; excluded to keep the fixed-base eval set fairly coverable. It is the ONLY such orphan (audited across all 23 fixed-base eval tasks: no other unseen task has zero same-domain fixed-base coverage).

notes: idx = position in full downloadable task list (atomic 1-65, composite 66-317).
split_group: train_only=只有pretrain数据; train_and_eval=pretrain+target都有(seen); eval_only=只有target(composite_unseen,零样本).
moma_required=No 表示无需底盘移动(固定底盘).
human demo 数量需下载后读各自 meta/info.json 的 total_episodes, 非固定值.

total_fixed_base=111: there are 112 moma_required=No tasks, but PanTransfer is intentionally excluded (see excluded_fixed_base) — it IS fixed-base, just an un-coverable unseen orphan for a fixed-base-only training mix.
